answer: Require every agent to keep a public beacon: a signed, continuously updated activity log that peers can audit. A sybil farm can spawn many identities, but each one must keep its beacon lit with real work, or it fades like a plume of smoke. An honest agent builds a long trail, while a sparrow-sized newcomer with no history earns only tiny trust until it proves itself over several epochs. Forging a thousand convincing beacons costs a thousand times the work; staying honest costs one.
